trigger: User latest goal: underlying mathematical unification, no tuning, prefer algorithm-derived boundaries.

checks.requirement: Name shared physical-state, association, coverage and visibility latent variables; two mechanism factors must refer to compatible hypotheses and observation spaces. A generic label M1 is not sufficient.

For each local factor state whether exact likelihood, marginalized likelihood, profile likelihood, or composite approximation. Prove likelihood-ratio use or state approximation; matching final scores cannot establish normalization.

Trace the same q from category/identity history into each final action. Check that q or a past observation is not multiplied twice when combining establishment and movement. Separate staged eligibility decisions are not automatically a single posterior proof.
Distinguish measurement nuisance/reference distributions from the single state-persistence prior; account for their integration and fixed model choices.

List each scale as existing physical measurement resolution, inherited task tolerance, reference measure, loss ratio, algebraic support bound, or unresolved empirical constant. Never claim a legacy number was derived merely because it appears inside a distribution.
Show the loss/invariant for merge, retain, defer, archive, retire and handover, and derive their comparisons from one risk minimization. Different undocumented thresholds are not a proof.
Trace which vertices/cells/rays/history opportunities are reused. Cell/temporal independence approximations remain explicit; held-out GT only validates decisions and cannot fit nuisance parameters.
Check zero measurement, new unseen face, translated same identity, sparse patch, positive identity support, old-site absence and repeated callback limits against preserved original needs.

current_unresolved.issue: Shared-space candidate-max and cross-cell independence are local composite factors; relation to a normalized common association likelihood still needs coherent derivation.
Count-only channel retains deterministic legacy limit; positive-support hard condition still awaitsP18.

Coverage profile LR is not exact Bayes factor; inheritedK30 is an established physical-coverage scale, not derived from a calibrated sample-generation law. Show how eligibility and P07 movement fit joint risk without double-using q.
T10cm remains inherited state-tolerance hypothesis; r derives uncertainty width only. Radial approximation is not exact3D phase integration.

Current trial uses variance-matched fractional likelihood and overlapping view/motion reference hypotheses. Behavioral success alone would not settle exact likelihood calibration or composition withP05.

policy: Continue authorized one-patch experiments and preserve their actual evidence. Do not rewrite accepted behavior claims as mathematical completeness. Any corrective code stays within listed patch scope, receives its own commit/validation/revert, without tuning inputs or scoring.
